text:
ana: quick question — can we pilot a console "silence mode" to suppress deprecation banners for a small set of tenants? getting a lot of noise from power-user teams and want to avoid churn while we stabilize v2 behavior

sam: curious what "silence mode" covers. just banners, or also retention of telemetry and quota signals?

ana: banners only at first. telemetry still collected — we need to track who hit the deprecated endpoints and token counts.

kai: +1 to keeping telemetry. if we mute banners we should add a separate signal in metrics so we know the true volume (not just who clicked the banner). propose metric: `api.deprec_silenced.count` and tag by `tenant_id` and `reason`

margo: dashboard ask: show a mini-experiment panel under the deprec page — toggles for cohorts, sample rate, and a quick preview of the banner copy. ops-friendly so PMs can preview impact before wide rollout.

ana: exactly. plan: pilot for 10 tenants, 7 days, sample banner exposure at 0%, 25%, 100% for comparators. need console UX + opt-in toggle + audit log.

sam: we also need to ensure billing/quota attribution still counts. if a tenant is silenced and they keep using v1, we should surface expected delta in the billing preview so CS isn't blind.

margo: agreed. add a per-tenant preview card: "Projected cost delta if tenant stays on v1 vs moves to v2". simple calc based on token rates and last 7d traffic.

kai: telemetry/implementation notes: we can wire a `silence_mode` boolean to routing metadata. router will still route by header, but we add tags to the access logs. example: 
```
X-Client-Version: v1
X-Redwood-Silence-Mode: true
```
Then ingestion pipeline can emit `deprec_silence` events.

sam: is there any risk of tenants relying on silence as a long-term workaround? we should limit pilot to 1 month max and auto-evaluate.

ana: yes, auto-expiry + manual extension by engineering/PM. we'll make it explicit in the audit log.

margo: UX copy: "Deprecation notices are temporarily hidden for this tenant as part of a migration pilot. We continue to collect usage and may re-enable warnings to protect your app." Thoughts?

kai: fine copy. add a link to migration docs and a checkbox: "I understand this is temporary" for the admin override.

ana: routing change required? dave, can we add the `X-Redwood-Silence-Mode` passthrough without touching proxy hot-path?

>dave: we can. small proxy patch to preserve header and add to access log. no route change. pseudo: 
```
if req.headers['x-redwood-silence-mode'] == 'true':
  log.passthru('deprec_silence', tenant=req.tenant)
```
I'll open a PR.

sam: telemetry alert config: create two alerts — (1) `silenced_tenant_usage_spike` if silenced tenants exceed baseline by 2x, (2) `migration-lag` if >80% of silenced cohort still on v1 after 30d.

margo: add a dashboard widget that surfaces both alerts and links to the tenant audit trail.

ana: one more: console rollout UX. Instead of a full banner toggle, add a small inline badge next to the version badge with a tooltip. Admins can click and "Temporarily hide deprecation" (modal). modal will show telemetry + projected cost delta.

kai: also add server-side sampling override so we can set `banner_sample_rate` per-tenant without redeploy. store in config service.

>dave: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/proxy/pulls/3214 — patch is minimal, unit tests included. will request review from eng-runtime. :deploy:

deploy-bot: deploy started for proxy PR 3214 by dave — canary to 3 hosts

margo: timeline proposal: UX mock by Wed, telemetry pipeline hook by Fri, proxy patch in canary end of week, pilot start next Tue.

sam: question for billing: do we want billing to auto-notify CS when tenant opt into silence? otherwise they might miss churn signals.

margo: yes, webhook to CS workspace + a row in the CS console. low-volume by design for pilot.

ana: ok, I'll draft the pilot doc and share in #customer-success tomorrow. thanks all. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded for proxy PR 3214 — canary healthy on 3/3 hosts

margo: filing follow-ups: (1) metrics ticket for `api.deprec_silenced.count` (2) dashboard mock (3) billing preview endpoint. assigning to kai/sam/dave.

sam: I'll handle alerts and billing preview API.

kai: I'll wire ingestion tags and sampling config.

>ana: uploaded pilot plan: https://docs.internal/redwood/pilots/silence-mode-v1 -> please review

margo: noted, will sync with CS after review. :eyes:
